title.zh: 企业团队与家庭办公多拨负载均衡：基于 iStoreOS / OpenWrt 的多机场带宽聚合与高可用容灾
title.en: Multi-WAN Load Balancing & Proxy Aggregation: High-Availability Failover via iStoreOS & OpenWrt

cluster.zh: 路由器固件与家庭网关

description.zh: 针对跨境电商团队、外贸工作室与重度极客家庭的高可用网络方案。详解双宽带多拨物理接入、iStoreOS 旁路由部署、基于 MWAN3 的多机场订阅负载均衡与全自动主备秒级故障转移实战。
description.en: Enterprise-grade high-availability networking manual for cross-border teams and home labs. Deploy multi-WAN broadband aggregation, MWAN3 multi-path routing, and multi-provider subscription load balancing on iStoreOS/OpenWrt.
